review.notes: Full normalized text diff of the OCR markdown against extracted text from all 32 physical PDF pages; physical page 30 was rendered (130 dpi) and visually inspected to confirm the reference [61] system name. No code fences exist in the OCR and the heading tree (sections 1-7 plus appendix) matches the PDF's numbered sections; the seven HTML tables survived with intact cells and the contributor/reference names read correctly (Baijun Ye, Zijie Zhao, Pepijn Kooijmans — the PDF's ij ligature was transcribed as plain ij). All other unmatched PDF lines are figure-internal text (Fig. 1 overview grid, Fig. 2 token-structure diagram, Fig. 3 tokenization labels, benchmark chart axes) that the embedded figure images already show.

patches.before: et al. RInf: Flexible and efficient
patches.after: et al. RLinf: Flexible and efficient
patches.evidence: Rendered physical p.30 reference [61] reads 'RLinf: Flexible and efficient large-scale reinforcement learning via macro-to-micro flow transformation' with a lowercase L in RLinf (visually confirmed at 130 dpi, taller than the capital-I misreading); the body text on physical p.29 also prints 'following RLinf [61]'. The OCR kept the body reading but dropped the L in the reference title.
